newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint ends steady vs basket, firmer vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Forint ends steady vs basket, firmer vs dlr.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished steady against the central bank's dollar/mark currency basket but firmer against the dollar in quiet Wednesday trade, dealers said.
The forint stayed strong against the currency basket, sticking to the central bank's resistance level, following dollar/mark moves.
It ended at 200.25 to one dollar, compared to 200.65/70 at midday and 199.92/97 at the opening.
"It was pretty quiet except when the dollar/mark saw large movements," said Noemi Koppendorfer of ABN-AMRO Magyar Bank.
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5-percent wide intervention range against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
